<translated_code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class C {
    istream* in;
    ostream* out;
    stringTokenizer st;
    bool eof;

    void submit() {
        nextInt();
        string s = nextToken();
        (*out) << fast(s) << "\n";
        // (*out) << slow(s) << "\n";
    }

    static const string BAD;
    string prepare(const string& s) {
        string sb;
        for (char c : s) {
            if (BAD.find(c) != string::npos) {
                sb.push_back(c);
            } else {
                sb.push_back('A');
            }
        }
        return sb;
    }

    int slow(const string& s) {
        string s2 = prepare(s);
        unordered_map<string, int> map;
        deque<string> que;
        que.push_back(s2);
        map[s2] = 0;

        while (true) {
            string s_curr = que.front();
            que.pop_front();
            int curD = map[s_curr];
            if (s_curr.find_first_of(BAD) == string::npos) {
                return curD;
            }
            for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < s_curr.size(); i++) {
                string nxt = swap(s_curr, i, i + 1);
                if (!nxt.empty() && map.find(nxt) == map.end()) {
                    map[nxt] = curD + 1;
                    que.push_back(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    string swap(const string& s, int i, int j) {
        if (s[i] == s[j]) return "";
        string buf = s;
        std::swap(buf[i], buf[j]);
        return buf;
    }

    static const string STR;
    int fast(const string& s) {
        string s2 = prepare(s);
        int n = (int)s2.size();

        vector<int> a(n);
        vector<vector<int>> pos(3);
        vector<int> sz(3, 0);

        vector<vector<vector<int>>> cntHere(3);
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
            cntHere[c] = vector<vector<int>>(n, vector<int>(3, 0));
        }

        vector<vector<int>> pref(n + 1, vector<int>(3, 0));

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = STR.find(s2[i]);
            int c = a[i];
            if (sz[c] >= (int)cntHere[c].size()) {
                cntHere[c].push_back(pref[i]);
            } else {
                cntHere[c][sz[c]] = pref[i];
            }
            if (sz[c] < (int)pos[c].size()) {
                pos[c][sz[c]] = i;
            } else {
                pos[c].push_back(i);
            }
            sz[c]++;
            for (int c2 = 0; c2 < 3; c2++) {
                pref[i + 1][c2] = pref[i][c2];
            }
            pref[i + 1][c] += 1;
        }

        int sz0 = sz[0], sz1 = sz[1], sz2 = sz[2];

        const int INF = 1000000;
        vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> dp(2,
            vector<vector<vector<int>>>(sz0 + 1,
                vector<vector<int>>(sz1 + 1,
                    vector<int>(sz2 + 1, INF)
                )
            )
        );

        int ans = INF;
        dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;

        for (int j0 = 0; j0 <= sz0; j0++) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 <= sz1; j1++) {
                for (int j2 = 0; j2 <= sz2; j2++) {
                    for (int last = 0; last < 2; last++) {
                        int idx = j0 + j1 + j2;
                        int curVal = dp[last][j0][j1][j2];
                        if (curVal == INF) continue;
                        if (idx == n) {
                            ans = min(ans, curVal);
                            continue;
                        }
                        if (j0 < sz0) {
                            int cost = max(j1 - cntHere[0][j0][1], 0) + max(j2 - cntHere[0][j0][2], 0);
                            dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2] = min(dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2], curVal + cost);
                        }
                        if (j1 < sz1 && last == 0) {
                            int cost = max(j0 - cntHere[1][j1][0], 0) + max(j2 - cntHere[1][j1][2], 0);
                            dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2] = min(dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2], curVal + cost);
                        }
                        if (j2 < sz2) {
                            int cost = max(j0 - cntHere[2][j2][0], 0) + max(j1 - cntHere[2][j2][1], 0);
                            dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1] = min(dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1], curVal + cost);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static const int INF = 1000000;

    string genStr() {
        int n = rand() % 15 + 1;
        string buf;
        buf.reserve(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            buf.push_back(STR[rand() % 3]);
        }
        return buf;
    }

    void stress() {
        for (int tst = 0;; tst++) {
            string s = genStr();
            int fast_res = fast(s);
            int slow_res = slow(s);
            if (fast_res != slow_res) {
                cerr << s << "\n" << fast_res << "\n" << slow_res << "\n";
                throw runtime_error("Mismatch");
            }
            cerr << tst << "\n";
        }
    }

public:
    C() {
        in = &cin;
        out = &cout;
        submit();
        // stress();
    }

    string nextToken() {
        while (st.empty()) {
            string line;
            if (!getline(*in, line)) {
                eof = true;
                return "";
            }
            stringstream ss(line);
            st = stringTokenizer(ss);
        }
        string token = st.next();
        return token;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(nextToken());
    }
};

const string C::BAD = "VK";
const string C::STR = "VKA";

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    C c;
    return 0;
}
